caption: The worked example laid out step by step. The orange step is the unit trap the chapter warns about: 20 µA must become 0.02 mA before averaging; the last box is the result — 0.0367 mA average current, about 54,500 hours or 6.2 years.

spec.title: Power budget of the soil-moisture node
spec.aria: A six-step flow computing the power budget of a soil-moisture node: period 3600 s with 2 s active and 3598 s asleep, sleep current converted to 0.02 mA, 131.96 mA·s of charge per period, 0.0367 mA average current, 54,500 hours of battery life, and 6.2 years.
